text:
sara: Heads-up I opened a docs PR adding a Ruby snippet for prefix prefetch + a short migration note about quant profiles. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4789 :sparkles:
ryan: Nice. Can you paste the Ruby snippet here so I can eyeball it quickly?
sara: Sure — gist excerpt in the PR. Main flow uses PrefetchClient with a block (`PrefetchClient.new do |c| ... end`) to ensure cleanup. Batching example uses batch_size: 6.
meera: UX note: we should be explicit that prefetch is per-route and show the Console path. Avoid "enable prefetch" wording.
sara: Updated copy to "configure per-route prefetch rules (Console -> Optimize -> Prefetch)" and added anchor `/console/optimize/prefetch#per-route`.
docs-bot: checklist: [x] PR opened, [ ] reviewer assigned, [ ] snippets linted, [ ] links validated, [ ] migration wording reviewed
ryan: Quick technical nit: Ruby SDK renamed `OldPrefetch` to `PrefetchClient` last quarter. Make sure snippet uses that and the `init` vs `setup` rename.
sara: Fixed to `PrefetchClient` and noted migration `OldPrefetch -> PrefetchClient (setup -> init)` in the migration note.
meera: For the quant profile wording avoid absolute claims like "no accuracy change". Suggest "no statistically significant quality regressions observed in our evals" and link to `/docs/optimize/evals/regression-alerts`.
sara: Good call, updated wording per meera and linked the evals guide. Also added a one-line perf note: "local A100 test: ~9ms/token, batch 6, seq 2048, qprof-ruby-int8" (kept it brief).
ryan: Also add test conditions bullet so folks can reproduce: - hw: A100 - batch: 6 - seq: 2048 - quant profile: qprof-ruby-int8
sara: Done.
ci-bot: md-lint passed, snippets/ruby-format failed (rubocop)
sara: Fixing rubocop warnings now.
(2m later)
sara: Pushed formatting fix and removed a debug puts.
ci-bot: snippets/ruby-format passed, link-checker: 1 external link redirects (partner marketplace)
ryan: Which external link?
sara: Partner marketplace URL had a 302. Updated to canonical marketplace URL.
docs-bot: checklist: [x] PR opened, [x] reviewer assigned (ryan), [x] snippets linted, [x] links validated, [ ] migration wording reviewed
meera: One more UX micro: add a fallback reminder: "If prefix not found, runtime falls back to the pinned model variant (v1-small)". Many customers assume prefetch creates prefixes.
sara: Added fallback note and a crosslink to `/docs/optimize/fallbacks`.
ryan: Code looks good. Small example improvement: show `begin ... rescue` around `prefetch` call to demonstrate error handling in examples.
sara: Added that pattern, pushed commit.
ci-bot: checks: all green, deploy preview built
sara: Merged and deployed to staging: https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/optimize/ruby-prefetch-migration
ryan: Smoke preview: renders fine, code block highlighting good.
meera: Verified anchors and links. lgtm.
sara: Thanks team! This should reduce confusion and a few support tickets. :tada:
